Extra Miles Energy 71.4V 6A Lithium Battery Charger
The Extra Miles Energy 71.4V 6A Lithium Battery Charger is a reliable and efficient charging solution designed for compatible lithium battery packs. With a regulated 71.4V DC output and 6A charging current, this charger is suitable for applications where a stable and controlled charging supply is required.
The charger is designed for use with compatible lithium battery systems and can be used for electric scooters, electric vehicles, custom lithium battery packs and other lithium battery applications, provided that the battery's required charging voltage matches the charger's output.
⚡ 71.4V / 6A Output
This charger provides a maximum DC output of 71.4V at 6A, delivering approximately 428W of charging power.
The controlled output helps provide consistent charging performance when used with a properly configured battery and BMS.
🔋 Designed for Lithium Battery Applications
The charger is suitable for compatible lithium battery packs used in EV and energy-storage applications. Before use, the battery's chemistry, series configuration, maximum charging voltage and BMS settings should be verified to ensure compatibility.
🛡️ Controlled & Reliable Charging
When used with a correctly configured battery management system, the charger can be part of a safe and controlled lithium battery charging setup.
The battery's BMS should always be correctly configured according to the battery chemistry and cell configuration.
🚗 Wide Range of Applications
The Extra Miles Energy 71.4V 6A charger can be used for compatible:
- Electric Scooter Batteries
- Electric Vehicle Battery Packs
- Lithium Battery Packs
- Custom Battery Packs
- EV Conversion Projects
- Energy Storage Systems
- Other compatible lithium battery applications

6. COMPATIBILITY NOTE
⚠️ Important
Before purchasing or connecting this charger, make sure that your battery pack is specifically designed for a 71.4V maximum charging input.
Battery chemistry and series configuration determine the required charging voltage. Do not select a charger only on the basis of the battery's nominal voltage.
Always verify:
- Battery chemistry
- Number of cells in series
- Maximum charging voltage
- BMS charging-voltage setting
- Charger polarity
- Battery manufacturer's recommended charging voltage
Using an incorrect charging voltage can damage the battery or BMS.
